title: Friend sees a black pyramid in Antarctica
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Friend sees a black pyramid in Antarctica, about recent at Antarctica, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have a friend who went down there and I think he was making a documentary or something and he saw this sort of black pyramid.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says a friend of his went to Antarctica, he thinks to make a documentary, and saw a kind of black pyramid there. He mentioned it while talking about Richard Byrd, the American polar explorer. If true, it would hint at some unknown structure hidden in the ice.
